And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Rakesh Chandra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Ram Sagar Yadav Hon'ble Om Prakash Tripathi,J.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned counsel for opposite party nos.1 to 4.

This transfer application has been moved by the applicant with a prayer to transfer the Misc. Case No.1031 of 2018, arising out of Case Crime No.22 of 2018, under sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P Act, Police Station Chunar, District Mirzapur from the court of Chief Judicial Magistrate, Mirzapur to the competent court of equivalent jurisdiction at District Sonbhadra.

Learned counsel for opposite party nos. 1 to 4 has no objection on the transfer application and submitted that case for divorce, application u/s 125 CrPC and Domestic Violence Act is pending in the court of Sonbhadra.
Both the parties are resident of Sonbhadra District.
Grounds for transfer the Misc. Case No.1031 of 2018 is sufficient.

Accordingly, this transfer application is allowed and Misc. Case No.1031 of 2018 is recalled from the court of CJM, Mirzapur and transfer to the court of CJM, Sonbhadra for expeditious disposal in accordance with law.
